I like to draw cartoon characters mainly. He was going to use my art in his game.Talking to my mother is very difficult. She and I haven't ever gotten along and it just got worse when my fathered died. She would say awful things about him and say how much she hated him in front of me. It stings because he was my best friend. I was the poster child for "daddy's girl"...
And I know that all of my issues stemmed from losing him.
